items.title: 68146_Russell Procope oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Not with a band. He did go, I think, earlier, with Ethel Waters, when he was with Black Swan. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, I suppose, I suppose he did, yes.

ctx.x: Yes, I travelled. But Fletcher, his traveling wasn't as extensive as let's say as Duke's was later on, Duke Ellington's band later on. You know, Fletcher never went further west than Chicago, and he never got further south than Oklahoma City. That was the extent of his traveling. Of course New England. But he never went to the deep South or whatever.
Not with a band. He did go, I think, earlier, with Ethel Waters, when he was with Black Swan.
Oh, I suppose, I suppose he did, yes. But I mean while I was with him with the band, no. There was one trip the band made without Fletcher, and Fletcher's wife was in charge of the band at that time.
